rics.meaning: Gross Capital Formation, Capital Investment Index — total investment level (GFCF + inventories).
rics.how_to_use: Use GFCF (aIDCGFCD/CA) for the cleaner investment-cycle signal. GCF includes inventories which add volatility.

rics.description: GFCF, Current Prices, Investment / Capital Formation, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GFCF (Current Prices) — gross fixed capital formation in nominal terms.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDGFCFR/C) for real cycle. Nominal version useful in fiscal arithmetic.
